title: Crunchy Pea & Mint Fish Bites
ingredients: fish fillets sufficient for 4 (white fish or salmon)
To serve: sweet potato wedges, green vegetables, lemon wedges
steps: In a food processor, whizz bread and oats to a fine crumb; empty into a bowl and set aside.
Add fish, peas and mint to food processor; pulse to combine (break down fish but don't purée).
Beat eggs in a bowl. Roll fish mixture into ~3cm balls (~28 total), dip in egg, then roll in breadcrumbs to coat.
Place on a lined, sprayed baking tray; spray tops; season with salt.
Bake on middle shelf 18 minutes until crisp and golden brown.
Serve with sweet potato wedges, green vegetables and lemon wedges.
notes: Save nearly-out-of-date bread or loaf ends in the freezer as breadcrumbs — handy for quick breaded chicken or fish.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
